result.brief: Ikeja Corporate Office for Ikeja Holdings Ltd in Ikeja, Lagos is a 3-storey corporate office block (01 Entry Level, 02 Floor, 03 Floor with Parapet and Roof) measured from an architectural-only IFC model with no supporting documents. Frame is mixed: in-situ circular concrete columns with precast 300x600 beams, isolated structural steel wide-flange members with K-series joists, and precast hollow-core upper floors with concrete topping. External envelope is largely aluminium curtain-wall glazing with granite-faced panels plus concrete block walls and block parapet, with flat concrete deck roof with tapered insulation and EPDM; internal partitions are metal stud with plasterboard lining. Model lacks foundations, reinforcement detailing, structural sizing, MEP services, drainage and external works, and many structural/finishes build-ups are unconfirmed.

facts.frame: In-situ circular concrete columns with precast concrete beams, isolated structural steel members and precast hollow-core upper floors - architectural model only, mixes and details to be confirmed
facts.storeys: 3 storeys (01 - Entry Level, 02 - Floor, 03 - Floor) plus Parapet and Roof

result.review_summary: Takeoff captures envelope and fit-out geometry well (curtain wall, blockwork, doors, hollow-core planks, ceilings, light fittings counted) but cannot be priced as a complete building. Substructure is slab-only with no foundations, upper-floor topping volume is disproportionate to plank area, stairs are split across multiple concrete lines with landings/runs held, and MEP is limited to 37 light fittings. QS must resolve foundations, topping thickness, stair duplication, and the extent of provisional Builder's work and services before BOQ issue; see questions and provisionals and confirm the single code query on steel stringers without model quantities.

questions.question: 39 of Stringer - Paint - 50 mm Width (Member, Ikeja_Office.ifc) have no quantities in the model and were measured from their 3D shape (m): check one against the drawings.

No foundations measured - ground slab, membrane and edge formwork only (L001-L005). Are footings / pile caps / ground beams / foundation walls omitted because architectural model only, and held IfcSlab Generic-400mm (2nr) and Pad 1 (1nr) foundation elements? Confirm foundation solution before BOQ.

Concrete topping to hollow-core L014 is 823.036 m3 over 3105.799 m2 planks L015, implying c.265mm average topping - excessive for a topping/screed. Confirm topping thickness/build-up and whether L014 duplicates slab-edge concrete L016 or structural screed? Do not price L014 as measured.

Stair concrete split as flights L022, landings L023 and separate flight L024, while 5no landings and 9no runs are held as AI-guessing. Is there double-counting or omission between measured and held stairs, and are precast versus in-situ stairs mixed? Reconcile stair schedule.

Architectural model only - where are mechanical, plumbing, drainage, power distribution, HVAC, fire fighting/detection and lifts? Only pendant and sconce fittings L059-L060 measured with wiring/conduit to be confirmed. Confirm all services will be provisional / by specialist or excluded.

Ground slab measured as two lines L004 175.993 m3 in 100mm slab and L005 33.516 m3 in slab - do these overlap or represent different thicknesses/areas? Total membrane 1999 m2 suggests very large footprint versus slab volumes. Clarify slab thickness and extent.

Column counts disagree: 170nr circular column formwork L006 versus 164nr 300mm dia concrete L008 plus 6nr 450mm dia L009. Confirm column schedule and whether formwork includes held or omitted columns?

Structural steel tonnages are tiny (joists 1.214t L010, beams 0.468-0.803t, columns 0.962t). Is steel limited to a feature/canopy while main frame is concrete, or is main steel frame missing from architectural model? Confirm frame extent and connection/fire-protection requirements.

Carpet L052 equals hollow-core area L015 exactly at 3105.799 m2, plus timber finish L053. Does carpet incorrectly cover WCs, lobbies, corridors and service areas that need tiling/screed? Confirm floor-finish zoning.

External block wall L026 equals insulation L028 and lining L050 at 783.62 m2; parapet block L027 equals insulation L029 at 168.824 m2. Confirm external wall build-up order, insulation type/thickness and whether plaster/render omitted in favour of plasterboard lining only?

Ventilation / openable windows unclear: only 24nr fixed 915x1220 windows L037 plus curtain-wall glazing L036. Are all curtain panels fixed glazing with no openable lights, louvres or mechanical ventilation strategy? Confirm.
Metal sunscreen panels L057 206.358 m2 versus 40nr held SHADE SUPPORT - are supports part of sunscreen system and is sunscreen quantity complete including fixings?

Roof measured as single composite line L032 1592.585 m2 with build-up, mix and thicknesses to be confirmed. Confirm falls, outlets, overflow, fascia/coping and roof access/maintenance provision separately?
